summary.text: Rebecca Himschoot, who is listed as not affiliated with a party, has represented District 2 (Sitka) in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Her legislative biography describes her as a retired elementary teacher who has lived in Sitka for 26 years and served on the Sitka Assembly.

During a 30-year career in education she was an Albert Einstein Distinguished Educator Fellow at the National Science Foundation and received the Presidential Award for Excellence in Mathematics and Science Teaching, per the biography.
